rationale: The stock gapped up ~14%, ran to $27.17, then collapsed nearly to $22.51 — a violent intraday reversal that has already played out, leaving price consolidating near the low with no clear next directional catalyst. Price is well below both the session VWAP ($25.00) and 5-min VWAP ($24.07), which favors bears, but the day's low at $22.51 is only ~4% away with volume tapering sharply, making a short entry here poor risk/reward. A long setup requires a confirmed reclaim of at least the 5-min VWAP, which hasn't occurred; absent news context and with the dominant intraday trend being strongly downward, I cannot identify a mechanical edge in either direction sufficient to commit capital.
